target_questions.question: How does pressure ratio affect penetration, volume, angle, and entrainment for an outward-opening hydrogen injector?
target_questions.target_basis: Tier 1 B028 ranks NPR and nozzle geometry as major controls; this experiment supplies an outward-opening geometry boundary.

evidence_candidates.claim_text: For the outward-opening injector, increasing pressure ratio increased axial/radial penetration and jet volume, while the reported entrainment rate decreased and spread angle was comparatively insensitive except at low ratios.
evidence_candidates.evidence_summary: Schlieren-derived jet metrics across pressure ratios 10-140 show geometry-specific penetration and entrainment scaling.

limitations: Outward-opening injector only; pressure-ratio definition and evolving chamber pressure limit direct comparison with steady round jets.
visual_verification: Targeted visual verification performed where numeric/glyph-dependent abstract claims required it; no figure digitization.
